description: This file defines a CSharpLanguageGenerator class for generating C# code snippets for Playwright automation, supporting different modes like library, MSTest, and NUnit. It includes methods for generating actions, headers, footers, and formatting code, as well as handling external dependencies and signal mappings.

classes.name: CSharpLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class for generating C# code snippets for Playwright automation, supporting multiple modes and generating actions, headers, footers, and formatted code.

classes.name: CSharpFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting C# code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates C# code for a given action in context.

methods.name: _generateActionInner
methods.description: Internal method to generate code for specific actions based on mode and action type.

methods.name: _formatPageAlias
methods.description: Formats page alias based on mode and context.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Generates specific method call code for actions like click, fill, navigate, etc.

methods.name: _asLocator
methods.description: Converts a selector into a locator string for C#.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for standalone or test runner modes.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for standalone mode.

methods.name: generateTestRunnerHeader
methods.description: Generates header code for test runner modes (NUnit or MSTest).

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates footer code, including storage state saving if specified.
